statusMeaning: PLANNED records approved scope, not implementation, CI, deployment or certification. Owner values are accountable functions, not assigned people. Test destinations are initial planned locations, not evidence of existing tests.

units.title: Product charter and requirements ledger
units.build: `PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md`, user-role matrix, scope/non-goals, approved-vs-proposed requirements, source-of-truth hierarchy, ADR process and versioned roadmap register.
units.acceptance: every feature in this plan has a stable requirement ID, owner, initial test destination and status; no memory-only feature is required for handoff; editorial principles and organizational/political independence are explicit.

units.title: Threat model, data map and privacy architecture
units.build: component/data-flow diagram, adversary model (harasser, malicious submitter, insider, hostile collaborator, compromised worker, provider, unauthorized requester), classification ledger, consent/publication trust boundaries, E2EESA inventory framework and risk register.
units.acceptance: negative test scenarios exist for anonymous reidentification, donor/political linkage, incorrect publication, sensitive metadata export, helper overreach and false E2EE claims; all intended recipients and decrypt-capable actors documented.

units.title: Monorepo, type safety, development tooling and CI
units.build: Next.js/TypeScript app shell, lint/format/typecheck, pinned dependencies, reproducible local Postgres/test storage, unit/integration test runners, secret scanning, dependency audit, PR template and branch protections.
units.acceptance: fresh clone installs and tests from README; intentionally failing CI blocks merge; no secrets exist in repo/history; healthy baseline build produces an immutable artifact and build SHA.

units.title: Versioned PostgreSQL schema and fixtures
units.build: migrations for initial principal, case, evidence, consent, grants, audit, job and publication entities; scoped DB roles; factory-generated fictional data; schema lint and migration rollback strategy.
units.acceptance: migrate a blank DB and upgrade a prior fixture; no cross-user row reads; referential integrity and necessary constraints fail closed; fixtures contain no real complainants or allegations.

units.title: Secure Intake engine adapter and compatibility contracts
units.build: version-pinned adapter for `Secure-Intake-Case-Workflow-Engine`; map generic submissions, state transitions, tasks, notes and audit into Project domain without embedding Archive editorial policy upstream. Define compatibility/feature flags and dependency failure behavior.
units.acceptance: real adapter tests (not just mocked interfaces) demonstrate exact supported upstream capabilities; incompatible or not-yet-released features are recorded as blockers and do not silently trigger a second generic engine or false readiness.

units.title: Environment configuration, readiness and operational skeleton
units.build: documented environment variables, synthetic local/staging setup, health/readiness separation, structured redacted logs, migration preflight, minimal Render/Neon/B2 deployment templates, per-service IAM boundaries.
units.acceptance: startup fails safely with missing secrets/DB; liveness cannot be mistaken for readiness; no public admin endpoints; staging and production resources cannot accidentally cross-connect.

units.title: Accounts, pseudonyms and anonymous recovery
units.build: account sessions, passkey-ready account policy, MFA for staff, anonymous principal and receipt/recovery-secret credential, private case status login, pseudonyms separate from legal identity.
units.acceptance: no email/phone required for anonymous submission; guessing tracking IDs grants nothing; replay/session fixation and lost-credential support-impersonation tests fail; privacy notice describes provider metadata limitations.

units.title: Deny-by-default resource authorization
units.build: central policy-as-code for roles, ABAC objects, restricted organizations, dual-control identity reveals, field/asset-granular grants and audited decisions.
units.acceptance: adversarial horizontal/vertical IDOR matrix is green; public helpers cannot see draft/private cases; administrator role alone does not decrypt sealed/identity compartments; all service jobs use scoped credentials.

units.title: Privacy choice and versioned consent engine
units.build: independent identity/publication/contact/processing/replication decisions, consent snapshots, disclosure preview, explicit recipient+asset scopes, withdrawal/new-asset rules.
units.acceptance: absence/staleness of any necessary consent blocks action; publication and sharing never inherit consent from unrelated toggles; change in privacy mode creates new version with audit; plain-language interface matches effective permissions.

units.title: Accessible testimony intake wizard
units.build: narrative fields, incident/date/location precision options, categories, requested remedy/help, safety concerns, multimedia field placeholders, language labels, resumable steps and privacy explanation.
units.acceptance: anonymous and named users can complete the wizard using keyboard/screen reader; potentially identifying details are optional except where absolutely necessary; every field has classification and schema validation.

units.title: Secure drafts, recovery and submit receipt
units.build: autosave/version conflicts, anonymous resume, contributor receipt, final submission checklist, draft expiry/deletion, unsubmitted restricted-data rules.
units.acceptance: conflicting revisions cannot silently erase content; draft never appears in public results; anonymous token authorizes only its cases; submit transaction cannot be double-executed by retries.

units.title: Resumable private object uploads
units.build: bounded direct-to-B2 multipart/chunk uploads via short-lived single-object grants, allowlisted formats, declared limits, incomplete upload cleanup, storage encryption and private-prefix policies.
units.acceptance: oversize/wrong-object/wrong-principal/expired upload requests are rejected; end-of-upload digest/size checks pass; no secret URLs in logs or public history; interrupted uploads resume safely.

units.title: Malware quarantine and parser safety
units.build: actual MIME/content verification, scanner integration, disposable isolated parser containers, safe media/document conversion pipeline, resource quotas, CDR where appropriate, quarantine decisions and explicit scan-unavailable statuses.
units.acceptance: harmless fixtures pass, malicious EICAR-style test fixtures block, zip bombs/parser faults/timeouts remain quarantined, and the system cannot promote unchecked files if scanner/worker unavailable.

units.title: Evidence integrity, provenance and handling ledger
units.build: original object versioning, SHA-256 integrity, source assertions, chain-of-handling append-only event records, evidence reference permissions, tamper detection, private export manifest.
units.acceptance: any changed evidence bytes fail digest validation; reviewer actions are attributable; copies and derivatives remain linked to the correct immutable originals without suggesting external authenticity; sealed fields never enter public digests/indexes.

units.title: Durable constrained media-job framework
units.build: durable outbox/jobs, leased workers, deduplication, retry/dead-letter controls, safe resource ceilings, isolated object credentials, cancellation, test fixtures and status UI.
units.acceptance: killed worker resumes or safely fails without data loss, duplicate jobs do not publish twice, poison files remain isolated and costs are bounded.

units.title: Original-preserving media normalization
units.build: safe FFmpeg transcode to agreed web formats and thumbnails, source metadata removal on derivatives, exact parent-child hashes, independent private/public storage classifications.
units.acceptance: original bytes unchanged, unsupported codecs fail gracefully, no EXIF/geolocation leaks in generated public candidate, processing never creates an implicitly public URL.

units.title: Anonymization and visual/audio redaction editor
units.build: blur/mask/manual overlay, voice pitch/timbre transform, audio muting, timing controls, document redaction, multi-person handling and user-facing preview; automated suggestions only, with manual confirmation.
units.acceptance: edited derivatives are nonreversible as exported files under documented threats; obvious metadata and transcript leaks are flagged; source remains private; UX explicitly does not guarantee anonymity.

units.title: Editable transcripts and accessible captions
units.build: captions/transcription (local or explicitly consented processor), VTT/SRT, multiple languages where available, accessible editor, transcript versioning and privacy linting.
units.acceptance: public captions appear only after consent and human approval; names removed from video but left in captions trigger a review block; third-party processing does not occur without recipient/vendor approval.

units.title: Contributor/redaction-review approval gate
units.build: synchronized before/after previews, audio/caption/redaction checklist, source/derivative manifest, field-by-field release request and second-review queue.
units.acceptance: replacing media or transcript invalidates previous approval; withdrawn consent blocks promotion; unaudited/private media never reaches public CDN, share previews or publication manifests.

units.title: Complete case workflow state machine
units.build: submit/hold/needs-info/review/publication-ready/published/revised/withdrawn/archived transitions with policy guards, timestamps, reason codes and upstream case-engine integration.
units.acceptance: impossible state edges, unauthorized transitions and bypass of quarantine fail; every transition has actor and reason evidence; processing/media readiness is independent of case state.

units.title: Restricted reviewer console and triage
units.build: assignment queues, risk flags, reviewer access escalation, safety handling, case notes, conflicts and task delegation.
units.acceptance: unassigned reviewers have no accidental protected access; urgent flags are visible to staffed roles without making false 24/7 claims; dual-control protected reveals require independent authorization; cases never leak across organizations.

units.title: Contributor status and follow-up inbox
units.build: restricted progress view, safe information requests, protected replies, additional evidence submissions, status explanation, contributor-initiated correction and release planning.
units.acceptance: anonymous user can reenter with recovery credential; generic emails do not contain allegation details; staff cannot send a message to a nonexistent external contact; status-only mode works with no email.

units.title: Consent-bound publication projector
units.dependencies: HEARD-09, HEARD-14, HEARD-20, HEARD-21, and HEARD-19 for any redacted-media publication.
units.build: allowlisted public publication schema, signed versioned manifest, private-to-approved-derivative promotion transaction, public asset IAM boundary and independently tested negative projections.
units.acceptance: C1/C2/C3 fields never appear in generated public tables/assets; each field/file was consented at the relevant version; stale approval, missing safe derivative or revoked permission aborts the whole publish operation.

units.title: Public Archive pages and media player
units.build: accessible landing/browse, public case page, chronological update history, redacted video/audio player, captions, copy/share and safe source attribution.
units.acceptance: SSR, crawler, CDN and social metadata see only public projection; media has captions/transcript alternatives; public routes return appropriate not-found/taken-down states without leaking hidden cases.

units.title: Public search, filtering and discovery
units.build: Postgres text search of *public projection only*, safe facets, sort/filter, canonical URLs, sitemap, abuse-resistant crawl/rate limits and index-removal workflow.
units.acceptance: searching private keywords yields nothing; unpublishing removes first-party index hits and search previews within the defined incident SLO; sensitive geographic precision does not leak through aggregates.

units.title: Evidentiary and source-status presentation
units.build: categories for personal narrative, submitted documents, externally checkable source, editorial corroboration, unresolved conflicts, correction and outcome with clear disclaimers and source references.
units.acceptance: uploaded file does not automatically become “verified”; absence of corroboration does not mechanically label a person dishonest; changed evidence labels and citations are versioned and reviewable.

units.title: Amendments, corrections, withdrawal and public revisions
units.build: contributor-approved revisions, visible public update notes, temporary unpublication, safe takedown, first-party cache/CDN/index purge and restoration guards.
units.acceptance: original restricted assets remain nonpublic; public snapshots are immutable versions but active serving can be disabled; withdrawn public posts do not reappear after stale background retries; limitations of outside replicas are explained.

units.title: Content disputes, abuse reports and legally reviewed release policy
units.build: report forms, moderation decisions, editorial correction/response workflow, appeals, urgent incident lane, qualified reviewers and legal process/retention procedures.
units.acceptance: reports do not expose complainant details to adverse parties; appeals can be separately reviewed; urgent unpublish is tested; evidence and private records are not erased in violation of documented valid holds; policy versions are recorded.

units.title: Helper registry, categories and credential verification
units.build: helper self-description, lawyer/researcher/investigator/advocate/journalist/artist/filmmaker/witness categories, optional vetted professional verification, affiliation and conflict-of-interest declarations.
units.acceptance: self-attestation is visually distinct from verified licensure; no unnecessary public helper personal information; organizational approval cannot grant case evidence access.

units.title: Mediated “I can help” offers
units.build: public/case-specific offers, safety review, contributor approve/decline/block controls, no direct email exposure, spam controls and offer history.
units.acceptance: anonymous visitors cannot obtain contributor contact details; declining an offer leaves private case inaccessible; contributor is never pressured into contact and can choose no-contact mode.

units.title: Contributor-controlled fine-grained evidence grants
units.build: scoped grants by person/resource/action/purpose/expiry, just-in-time reviewer disclosures, access logs, revocation and cryptographic-key-change signaling.
units.acceptance: unauthorized originals/captions/notes fail at API **and storage** layers; future newly added records require their own grants; revocation blocks new access and the UI truthfully discloses limits on prior copies.

units.title: Protected contributor-helper messaging
units.build: message transport and narrowly scoped E2EE endpoint experience using an independently reviewed, pinned profile **if available and actually implemented**; explicit key-change notice, participant recipient confirmation and metadata policy; otherwise keep this work gated or provide honestly labeled managed-confidential messaging with separate approval.
units.acceptance: negative tests for changed recipient keys, replay, unauthorized message reads, lost keys and exfiltration; E2EE not claimed for any server-readable workflow; message access is not granted merely by helper status.

units.title: Restricted case collaboration, tasks and notes
units.build: tasks, case-specific note compartments, controlled attachments, handoffs, outcome tracking and links to associated testimony/source material.
units.acceptance: lawyer and journalist notes do not leak between roles; case handoff requires recipient approval and logs; collaborators cannot publish contributor information merely by marking a task complete.

units.title: Minimal, reliable participant notifications
units.build: in-app notices, optional email, delivery failures, unsubscribe/prefs, batching and durable retries with template metadata minimized by sensitivity.
units.acceptance: no confidential story titles/files/body in subject lines or provider metadata; bounced/disabled contacts generate honest UI status; duplicate sends are idempotent.

units.title: Partner organizations and scoped referrals
units.build: organization records, membership verification, referral requests, recipient acceptance, duty/scope limits, audit and safe disconnect/offboarding.
units.acceptance: an organization sees only cases granted to it; removing a staff member terminates their future access; no automatic blanket case forwarding.

units.title: Justice For All core platform integration
units.build: shared site navigation, style, privacy-safe cross-app links, approved identity federation/OIDC and public participation counts; keep political campaign/party and case-service purposes separated.
units.acceptance: SSO never confers Archive access without Archive grants; no enrollment in party, campaign or marketing database without distinct voluntary consent; standalone app functions if core platform is unavailable.

units.title: FOIA Aggregator citation and public-source bridge
units.build: link records by external source/provenance IDs and authoritative URLs; fetch/validate public-record metadata without copying private evidence into the FOIA corpus.
units.acceptance: bad/deleted/unavailable citations are labeled; no cross-origin proxy SSRF; there are no write permissions from the Archive into public FOIA storage.

units.title: Optional Liberty Nodes public dissemination export
units.build: explicit separate consent to distributed replication, signed allowlisted public asset manifests, exported version/revocation notices, deterministic verification and documentation of irrevocability limits.
units.acceptance: private fields/originals and identities withheld from publication cannot appear in node packages; replication off by default; the user is warned before consenting that replicas may persist after withdrawal.

units.title: Typed public/partner API, signed events and SDK
units.build: complete OpenAPI 3.1, external docs, scoped service tokens, partner event registry, signed webhooks, replay defense, outbox delivery, samples and contract tests for Witness Corps/Justice Teams/Justice Works.
units.acceptance: duplicate/out-of-order deliveries are harmless; secret data does not cross public/default webhook fields; integrations disable cleanly if downstream recipients fail.

units.title: E2EESA evidence register and conformance remediation
units.dependencies: HEARD-02, HEARD-08, HEARD-09, HEARD-23, HEARD-31, HEARD-32, HEARD-38, HEARD-39.
units.build: implementation-bound component inventory, flow/recipient matrix, cryptographic property evidence, upstream standard version pins, tests for unauthorized derived-content egress, audited gaps and independent reviewer queue.
units.acceptance: no E2EE/security property is marked passed by a schema fixture alone; remaining audit/remediation gaps block the corresponding production claims; passing source/test evidence is not misrepresented as deployment certification.

units.title: Participant data export, retention and deletion requests
units.build: export of authorized private materials with integrity manifest, verified deletion request tracking, limited/legal-hold handling, backup lifecycle, expired grant and account cleanup.
units.acceptance: request fulfillment cannot disclose other people’s data, private original versions are not in public archives, deletion jobs report exact completed/pending scopes and cannot claim remote replica erasure.

units.title: Privacy-preserving analytics and administrator operations
units.build: case/workflow funnel metrics, moderation queues, publication lead times, helper status, worker/storage quota utilization, review aging, abuse signals, limited export, admin audit dashboards.
units.acceptance: public counts cannot reidentify tiny private groups; no raw confidential content in telemetry; operational health reflects current sourced observations rather than inferred green status.

units.title: Security hardening and adversarial test suite
units.dependencies: HEARD-13, HEARD-21, HEARD-23, HEARD-31, HEARD-32, HEARD-39, HEARD-40.
units.build: ASVS 5.0.0 requirement mapping, authz/fuzz/property tests, file parser probes, SSRF/signed URL/CSP protections, key lifecycle checks, rate limits, dependency/SBOM and supply-chain review.
units.acceptance: high/critical findings closed or publicly documented hard gates preventing affected feature release; automated attempts at every restricted asset/field fail; independent tester can reproduce test matrix and evidence.

units.title: WCAG 2.2 AA, usability and language review
units.build: audit of entire journey, keyboard/screen-reader focus, mobile, contrast, reduced motion, video captions, plain-language trauma-aware help, comprehension testing of anonymity/replication/consent.
units.acceptance: automated and human accessibility checks record findings; blind/keyboard-only contributor can submit and manage a private case; usability tests demonstrate users understand what is made public.

units.title: Reliability, recovery, capacity and cost safety
units.build: measured backup+restore, secret/key recovery controls, recovery runbook, load and resumable-upload tests, worker saturation and outage drills, storage quotas, CDN limits, cost alarms and deletion/retry tests.
units.acceptance: actual clean-environment restore reconstructs authorized case/evidence; recovery-time and recovery-point targets measured; no queue/media outage can create unintended publication; hard cost caps block runaway jobs without losing queued items.

units.title: Production-ready Render/Neon/B2 deployment
units.dependencies: HEARD-06, HEARD-23, HEARD-32 if protected messaging enabled, HEARD-43, HEARD-45.
units.build: CI/CD promotion with pinned images, SQL migration safeguards, protected staging and production, scoped environment credentials, readiness/probe checks, release SHA, preflight, rollback and change calendar.
units.acceptance: each service runs in the **authorized** Render project with correct Neon/B2 resources; health and full dependency readiness actually checked; failed migration/deploy rolls back; no plaintext production secret in source or logs.

units.title: Engine Room integration and operating evidence
units.build: project registry entry, planned/merged/remaining PR mapping, observed CI status, source/version deployment identity, uptime/readiness, storage cost, backups, incidents, security blockers and freshness indicators.
units.acceptance: project appears with valid progress bar grounded in real GitHub facts; stale/unconfigured data labeled unknown; dashboard links to exact repository, actual live site and operating runbooks.

units.title: Controlled beta, independent review and GA release gate
units.dependencies: HEARD-28, HEARD-35, HEARD-38 if enabled, HEARD-40, HEARD-43, HEARD-44, HEARD-45, HEARD-46, HEARD-47.
units.build: scripted pilot with consenting synthetic/approved participants, staged safety monitoring, externally reviewed security/privacy/media risks, legal/editorial approvals, response rehearsal, launch docs, versioned release manifest and known-limitations page.
units.acceptance: complete participant journeys A-D pass on production-like services; no critical open privacy/security issues; staff roles and incident contacts assigned; production alerting and backups demonstrated; version/release/deploy SHA verified; independent reviewer findings resolved or blocked by disabled features; final Go/No-Go signed with evidence, not self-declared merely because 48 PRs merged.
